alloy_build_info.help: A metric with a constant '1' value labeled by version, revision, branch, goversion from which alloy was built, and the goos and goarch for the build.

alloy_component_controller_evaluating.help: Tracks if the controller is currently in the middle of a graph evaluation

alloy_component_dependencies_wait_second.help: Time spent by components waiting to be evaluated after their dependency is updated.

alloy_component_evaluation_queue_size.help: Tracks the number of components waiting to be evaluated in the worker pool

alloy_component_graph_connection.help: Indicates that two components are connected in the graph

alloy_config_hash.help: Hash of the currently active config file.

alloy_config_last_load_success_timestamp.help: Timestamp of the last successful configuration load.

alloy_prometheus_relabel_cache_ttl_evict.help: Number of relabel cache entries removed by the periodic TTL scan. Always 0 when cache_ttl is unset.

alloy_resources_machine_rx_bytes_total.help: Total bytes, host-wide, received across all network interfaces.

alloy_resources_machine_tx_bytes_total.help: Total bytes, host-wide, sent across all given network interface.

alloy_resources_process_cpu_seconds_tota.help: Total user and system CPU time spent in seconds.

alloy_resources_process_start_time_secon.help: Start time of the process since unix epoch in seconds.

db_query_duration_seconds.help: Duration of database queries in seconds

db_sql_latency_milliseconds.help: The latency of calls in milliseconds

http_client_duration_milliseconds.help: Measures the duration of outbound HTTP requests.

http_client_request_body_size_bytes.help: Size of HTTP client request bodies.

http_client_request_duration_seconds.help: Measures the duration of outbound HTTP requests.

http_client_request_size_bytes.help: Measures the size of HTTP request messages.

http_client_response_size_bytes.help: Measures the size of HTTP response messages.

http_server_active_requests.help: Measures the number of concurrent HTTP requests that are currently in-flight.

http_server_duration_milliseconds.help: Measures the duration of inbound HTTP requests.

http_server_duration_seconds.help: Measures the duration of inbound HTTP requests.

http_server_request_duration_seconds.help: Duration of HTTP server requests in seconds

http_server_request_size_bytes.help: Measures the size of HTTP request messages (compressed).

http_server_requests_total.help: Total number of HTTP server requests

http_server_response_size_bytes.help: Measures the size of HTTP request messages (compressed).

jvm_class_loaded_total.help: Number of classes loaded since JVM start.

jvm_class_unloaded_total.help: Number of classes unloaded since JVM start.

jvm_cpu_count.help: Number of processors available to the Java virtual machine.

jvm_cpu_recent_utilization_ratio.help: Recent CPU utilization for the process as reported by the JVM.

jvm_cpu_time_seconds_total.help: CPU time used by the process as reported by the JVM.

jvm_gc_duration_seconds.help: Duration of JVM garbage collection actions.

jvm_memory_used_after_last_gc_bytes.help: Measure of memory used, as measured after the most recent garbage collection event on this pool.

otel_sdk_span_live.help: The number of created spans with `recording=true` for which the end operation has not been called yet.

otelcol_exporter_sent_spans_total.help: Number of spans successfully sent to destination. [Alpha]

otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans_total.help: Number of spans successfully pushed into the pipeline. [Alpha]

otelcol_receiver_failed_spans_total.help: The number of spans that failed to be processed by the receiver due to internal errors. [Alpha]

otelcol_receiver_refused_spans_total.help: Number of spans that could not be pushed into the pipeline. [Alpha]

process_runtime_go_cgo_calls.help: Number of cgo calls made by the current process

process_runtime_go_gc_count_total.help: Number of completed garbage collection cycles

process_runtime_go_gc_pause_ns.help: Amount of nanoseconds in GC stop-the-world pauses

process_runtime_go_gc_pause_ns_total.help: Cumulative nanoseconds in GC stop-the-world pauses since the program started

process_runtime_go_goroutines.help: Number of goroutines that currently exist

process_runtime_go_mem_heap_released_byt.help: Bytes of idle spans whose physical memory has been returned to the OS

process_runtime_go_mem_heap_sys_bytes.help: Bytes of heap memory obtained from the OS

process_runtime_go_mem_live_objects.help: Number of live objects is the number of cumulative Mallocs - Frees

process_runtime_go_mem_lookups_total.help: Number of pointer lookups performed by the runtime

rpc_client_call_duration_seconds.help: Measures the duration of an outgoing Remote Procedure Call (RPC).

rpc_client_duration_milliseconds.help: Measures the duration of inbound RPC.

rpc_client_request_size_bytes.help: Measures size of RPC request messages (uncompressed).

rpc_client_requests_per_rpc.help: Measures the number of messages received per RPC. Should be 1 for all non-streaming RPCs.

rpc_client_response_size_bytes.help: Measures size of RPC response messages (uncompressed).

rpc_client_responses_per_rpc.help: Measures the number of messages received per RPC. Should be 1 for all non-streaming RPCs.

rpc_server_call_duration_seconds.help: Measures the duration of an incoming Remote Procedure Call (RPC).

rpc_server_duration_milliseconds.help: The duration of an inbound RPC invocation

rpc_server_request_size_bytes.help: Measures size of RPC request messages (uncompressed).

rpc_server_requests_per_rpc.help: Measures the number of messages received per RPC. Should be 1 for all non-streaming RPCs.

rpc_server_response_size_bytes.help: Measures size of RPC response messages (uncompressed).

rpc_server_responses_per_rpc.help: Measures the number of messages received per RPC. Should be 1 for all non-streaming RPCs.
